features: 5.1 CHANNEL HOME THEATRE SYSTEM: OSCAR OSC-625 home theatre system features a 5.25-inch woofer and five satellite speakers with 3.5-inch drivers as specified, creating a dedicated multi-speaker audio setup for enjoying movies, music, television programmes and everyday entertainment at home.

80W OUTPUT POWER: Experience your favourite entertainment with an 80W output power speaker system designed for home audio use. The combination of a subwoofer and satellite speakers helps deliver a balanced listening experience for music playback, movie watching and compatible audio content.

MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Enjoy flexible audio playback with Bluetooth, FM radio, AUX input, USB connectivity and an SD card reader. Connect compatible devices or play supported audio files through your preferred input, making this speaker system suitable for different home entertainment needs.

KARAOKE WITH WIRELESS MICROPHONE: Make music sessions and home gatherings more enjoyable with karaoke functionality and the included wireless microphone. The full-function remote control provides convenient access to supported system settings, volume adjustments and playback options from a distance.

EQUALIZER CONTROL AND LED DISPLAY: Adjust supported audio settings using the equalizer controls to suit your listening preferences. The LED display helps you view relevant system information and navigate available functions for a convenient and user-friendly home audio experience.

REMOTE CONTROL AND 1-YEAR WARRANTY: The OSCAR OSC-625 comes with a full-function remote control for convenient operation and a stated 1-year warranty with home service, subject to applicable warranty terms and service availability. Its multi-speaker design makes it a practical choice for everyday home entertainment.
